links.outcome: Antibiotic administration delays following LLM augmentation of sepsis alerts
links.effect: Median BPA-to-antibiotic time decreased from 140.4 to 112.1 minutes; median ED-admission-to-antibiotic time decreased from 325.0 to 274.0 minutes.
links.quote: Importantly, this shift in BPA acknowledgement patterns was not associated with delays in sepsis management (Table 2 ), with median time from BPA firing to antibiotics decreasing from 140.4 to 112.1 minutes.
